summary: C3is Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, announcing a one-for-seven reverse stock split effective April 26, 2026, with the adjusted common stock trading on Nasdaq from April 27, 2026. The split reduces outstanding shares from ~3.7 million to ~528,305, with proportionate adjustments to warrants and Series A Convertible Preferred Stock. No fractional shares will be issued; cash payments will be made in lieu. The split aims to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing. This is a routine corporate action to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation. Watch for the stock price to stabilize above $1.00.
